description: Curated Test Fault Data Set is a data set deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors Janghyun Kim, Matt Leach. The curated fault experiment data set consists of tagged and fully described time series representing measured faults from the AFDD test building (ORNLs Flexible Research Platform [FRP]), including baseline performance and faulty performance. A total of 10 different faults are tested for 49 different faulted and unfaulted scenarios with various fault intensity levels. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 3 files. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
